class_descriptions.plastic: Thermoplastic polymers including PET bottles, HDPE jugs, and LDPE containers.
class_descriptions.paper: Bleached and unbleached wood pulp paper, newspapers, magazines, and office sheets.
class_descriptions.glass: Silica-based containers, jars, and beverage bottles.
class_descriptions.metal: Aluminium beverage cans, tin food cans, and scrap ferrous metal.
class_descriptions.cardboard: Corrugated cardboard boxes, unbleached packaging, and rigid cartons.
class_descriptions.organic: Compostable biomass, fruit and vegetable peels, and food scraps.
